name: nldbd-energy-matched-auc
artefact_version_note: version of the frozen artefacts (evaluator, profiles, manifests); manifests must carry this value. The benchmark version increases on any change; the artefact version only when a frozen artefact changes.
description: NLDBD event classification benchmark: energy-matched AUC (EnergyBench strict600) on frozen official splits.

label_regimes.rule: np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n_train)[:round(f*n_train)], positions into the canonical train order; nested

coarse.rule: smallest candidate fraction >= the dataset's coarse_min_fraction on which the primary metric is estimable and each class keeps >= coverage_ratio x the full validation split's matched coverage

modes.coarse: frozen subset of the validation split; development only
modes.full: complete frozen test split; the benchmark

mjd.title: MAJORANA DEMONSTRATOR
mjd.positive_class: clean pulse (all four PSD flags true)
mjd.split_source: rule in readers/mjd.py (official Test files; seeded 90/10 of Train)

next.title: NEXT
next.energy: float64 sum of hit energies (MeV) -> keV
next.coarse_min_fraction_reason: 0.5 % (583 events) was estimable but noisy; with the combined file 10 % still scores in seconds
